title: Finite odd-Hermite score projections give a monotone Fisher lower hierarchy

theorem.gram_product: H_m H_n=sum_(k=0)^min(m,n) k! binom(m,k) binom(n,k) H_(m+n-2k)
theorem.finite_test: J(Y)>=2 alpha^T b-alpha^T G alpha for every real alpha
theorem.optimized_test: J(Y)>=b^T G^(-1)b when G is positive definite
theorem.basis: Any finite ordered set of odd probabilists' Hermite polynomials.

scope_guard: This is a universal finite-test lower bound. Equality with full relative Fisher requires the true relative score to lie in the selected polynomial span and is not asserted.
